measurement_note: Size is n, the number of stock-price points. Each tier shuffles the days 1 through n and assigns price = day^2, so sorting is mandatory and every chronological edge has a different slope. One comparison sort takes O(n log n) time. Correctly sorting the entire remaining list after each extracted point completes all tiers and fails through O(n^2 log n) scaling.
